full.file_describe:
FOrcaSlicer 2.3.2-fos.8.6.8

Fixed: projects from Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer or Snapmaker Orca that give each part or object its own filament, as many MakerWorld models do, opened with every part in filament 1 and were sliced that way. Each part now keeps its filament, in the 3D view and in the sliced result.

Colors painted directly onto the model were not affected, and projects saved by FOrcaSlicer open as before.

Linux AppImage: needs glibc 2.35 or newer, FUSE 2 and WebKitGTK 4.1 from your system.
